blurb: As of July 2026, the Piedmont Triad Economic Activity Index stands at 108.3 — 8.3 points above the 2019 baseline and 5.6 points above the pre-recession peak of 102.7 recorded in 2007, the highest level in the index’s history. The region is in a Flat phase. Growth Momentum is 71 out of 100, above the 50-point neutral threshold, indicating growth is running faster than the historical norm. Labor Utilization stands at 98.1, 1.9 points below the 2019 baseline.
